text:
[Photograph: A diploma from Savoy Male and Female College. The text reads in part:

SAVOY
MALE AND FEMALE
COLLEGE.

Be it Known That

The Faculty and Trustees of this Institution, by authority vested in us by the Legislature of the State of Texas, a major report

W. J. Hunt

is a candidate among the four degree in theAbile, approved by the required examination, is entitled to receive the Degree of Bachelor of Arts, with all the privileges and honor pertaining to that Degree.

In testimony of which we have signed our names and affixed the Seal of this College this [?] day of [?] 1887.

FACULTY.
[Signatures:] E. R. Halsell, President
George Harshaw, Vice-President
Halsell[?], Treasurer
C. H. Ditchell[?], [?]

TRUSTEES.
James Norton, President of Board of Trustees
[Additional signatures illegible]]
notes: Page 58 of printed book. Photograph of the A.B. diploma awarded to W. J. Hunt, labeled No. 3, dated 1887. Signed by faculty including E. R. Halsell (President) and George Harshaw (Vice-President), and trustees including James Norton. Some signatures partially illegible.
